name: Space & Astronomy Pack
description: Deep space phenomena, planetary orbits, and interstellar vocabulary.

words.definition: A system of millions or billions of stars, together with gas and dust.
words.exampleSentence: The Milky Way is a spiral galaxy containing billions of solar systems.

words.definition: The sixth planet from the sun, known for its prominent system of rings.
words.exampleSentence: Telescopic observations show complex ring structures around Saturn.

words.definition: A cloud of gas and dust in outer space, visible in the night sky.
words.exampleSentence: Stars are born inside the dense dust clouds of a stellar nebula.

words.definition: The curved path of a celestial object or spacecraft around a star or planet.
words.exampleSentence: Satellites maintain a stable geostationary orbit around the Earth.

words.definition: A celestial object consisting of ice and dust that displays a bright tail near the sun.
words.exampleSentence: Halley's Comet completes its elliptical orbit approximately every 75 years.

words.definition: A massive and extremely remote celestial object emitting exceptionally large amounts of energy.
words.exampleSentence: Quasars are powered by supermassive black holes at the centers of distant galaxies.

clues.clue: A massive cosmic system of billions of stars and planetary systems.
The sixth planet famous for its majestic planetary rings.
An interstellar cloud of luminescent gas and stellar dust.
The gravitational path traced by an orbiting celestial body.
An icy celestial body that develops a glowing tail near a star.
